hero.title: Radomska 5
hero.subtitle: Residential architecture in Łódź
hero.lead: A small residential building shown in concept visualisations. Offer details will follow once they are approved.
hero.poster: Concept visualisation: the Radomska 5 building at sunset, seen from the street.
hero.disclaimer: Concept visualisation. It does not show a completed building.
hero.beat: From the street to the lobby, in one continuous shot.

concept.title: A compact volume, a calm rhythm of windows.
concept.body: In the visualisations the building is a white, geometric volume on a dark base, with glazed balconies and a regular pattern of windows. The project is at concept stage.
concept.drawing: Schematic drawing of the facade: three storeys of three windows above a dark base.
concept.note: Preliminary data. Until it is confirmed we do not publish the finishing standard, dates or floor areas.

gallery.title: The volume from three sides
gallery.frontAlt: Visualisation: the front elevation, three storeys of windows with textured cladding, a dark ground floor and the entrance.
gallery.angle1Alt: Visualisation: the building seen from a street corner, with balconies on the left side of the volume.
gallery.angle2Alt: Visualisation: a corner of the building with balconies, a dark courtyard facade and the Radomska sign.
gallery.note: All views show the architectural concept and may differ from the final design.

finance.title: Buy at your own pace.
finance.lead: The proposed concept: an initial payment, then the rest in instalments spread over many years, paid directly to the company.
finance.badge: Concept of a financing model. Terms require confirmation by the developer.
finance.term: to spread the remaining amount into instalments
finance.barRest: Instalments: the remaining 70%, up to 25 years
finance.barLabel: Diagram: a 30% initial payment, then the remaining amount in instalments of up to 25 years.
finance.p1: 30% of the apartment price as the initial payment
finance.p2: The remaining amount in instalments, up to 25 years
finance.p3: Payments made directly to the company, without a conventional mortgage
finance.p4: Schedule, instalment amounts and other terms: to be confirmed
finance.fine: This presentation is conceptual. It is not an offer in the legal sense and not a guarantee. Instalment amounts, any costs and eligibility terms will be set by the developer.

interior.title: An entrance that invites you in.
interior.body: A visualisation of the lobby: dark cladding, timber slats and a concrete bench under linear light. It is a vision of the interior, not documentation of a completed space.
interior.alt: Visualisation: the entrance lobby with timber slats, a dark wall, a concrete bench and a line of light on the wall.
